Their positioning is particularly relevant because they have experience rooted in the wedding/events industry, including wedding SEO, keyword research, competitor positioning, portfolio optimization and seasonal planning. That makes them worth speaking to about searches such as “bridal alterations Toronto,” “wedding dress alterations near me,” and “bridal seamstress Toronto.”

Grapevine Media — strong wedding-industry specialization.
This Toronto-based agency explicitly markets itself as a digital marketing agency for Canadian wedding businesses, with services aimed at Google rankings, websites and lead generation.

What I'd actually buy in your position

For bridal alterations, I'd not start with broad social-media marketing. I'd build a system around:

Google Maps + Google Search → dedicated bridal alterations page → fitting enquiry/booking

The valuable searches are high-intent phrases like:

bridal alterations Toronto

wedding dress alterations Toronto

wedding gown alterations near me

bridal seamstress Toronto

wedding dress hemming Toronto

bridal dress fitting Toronto

last-minute wedding dress alterations Toronto

[Toronto neighbourhood] bridal alterations

Then use Instagram/Facebook primarily to retarget people who visited your site, rather than making them your main acquisition channel.

The provider I'd contact first

I'd speak to EC Marketing Agency and Grapevine Media first, because the wedding-industry experience is a meaningful advantage. I'd then get a quote from Kavana Digital as the performance/Google-focused benchmark.

When you talk to them, don't ask “Can you do my marketing?” Ask:

“Can you generate and track qualified bridal fitting enquiries in Toronto, and show me the expected cost per enquiry?”

That forces the conversation away from followers, impressions and website traffic and toward the thing that actually pays you.

If you tell me roughly your average alterations/fitting revenue per bride and your monthly marketing budget, I can narrow this to the best 2–3 providers and the exact marketing strategy I'd use for your business.

ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.
